headline: Fun-size morning windswell, light winds early then onshore afternoon.
today: Waist-high SSE at short period, but the dawn and morning are light N/NE so it'll have shape before the ESE onshore comes up in the afternoon. Morning is the play — fish or groveler on the low-to-mid tide. Nothing to write home about but surfable.

daysToWatch.note: Good SE angle with a bit more period, light morning winds and an offshore W evening. The cleanest window of the week here.
Prime ESE angle at longer period, light W/WSW morning and offshore evening. Small but clean — worth a look dawn or dusk.
